title: Kadane's Algorithm
definition: An elegant O(N) Dynamic Programming algorithm to find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray. At each step, it calculates `currentMax = Math.max(nums[i], currentMax + nums[i])`.
simpleExplanation: At every step, you ask: 'Should I add this number to my existing streak, or is my streak so bad that I should just start a brand new streak right here?'

answers.question: **Basic:** Kadane's Algorithm (Max Subarray Sum)
**Intermediate:** Maximum Product Subarray
